build_fm_index: build a FMIndex from a KILT or DPR formatted input file and save it to disk
preprocess_file_kilt: preprocess a KILT formatted file with optional lowercase and tokenization
preprocess_file_dpr: preprocess a DPR formatted file with optional lowercase and tokenization
build_index_multiprocess: build an FMIndex using multiprocessing pool to tokenize and initialize sequences
parse_cli_args: parse command-line arguments for input, output, format, jobs, and tokenization options
